title: Cozy Horrors
description: A horror - yet cozy modpack which you can explore and get jumpscared.
body:
**Cozy Horrors**... The fireplace is warm. The stew is hot. But don't look out the cabin window...
Welcome to Cozy Horrors, a unique Minecraft experience where peaceful, comfortable homesteading collides with spine-chilling stalker terror. This modpack is crafted for players who love aesthetic building, farming, and cooking, but still want to feel a creeping sense of pure dread the second the sun goes down.

Can you build your dream countryside retreat while surviving the horrific entities which are lurking in the dark?

 
# 


### What is included:

**🏡 The Cozy Side**

**Vineyards & Orchards:**
Grow grapes, mash them into juices, and ferment your own custom wine ages using Vinery. 

**Gourmet Kitchens:**
Expand your culinary skills with Farmer's Delight and Chef's Delight to cook up comforting, hearty meals.

**Rustic Wilderness Living:**
Set up beautiful campsites, pitch tents, and backpack across the world with the Camping mod and Traveler's Backpack.

**Beautiful Seasons:**
Watch the leaves turn and flowers bloom as you manage your crops through the immersive climate changes of Serene Seasons.

# 

**👁️ The Horror Side**

**Intelligent Stalkers:** 
You are never truly alone. The Midnight Lurker, The Goatman, and The Man From The Fog will actively stalk you from the woods, watch you from a distance, and linger outside your windows.

**Echoes in the Dark:**
Immersive directional audio from Sound Physics Remastered means every creak of your floorboard, 
drop of water, and distant woodland shriek will echo realistically through your homestead. 

**Environmental Paranoia:**
Thick, heavy fog and ambient soundscapes warp your surroundings, turning a simple daytime resource run into a claustrophobic nightmare.

**The Sanctuary Dynamic:**
Your cozy home isn't just for decoration anymore. It is your physical shield. Lock your double doors, light your lanterns, and pray that whatever is scratchng at your walls can't find a way inside.

And don't forget.. Pour a warm drink, lock your doors, and brace yourself.
